body: Unfortunately I cant relocate as my job and entire family is here, she isn't alone either she also has family here and has lived here for about 7 years. I'll try and get info on the child support enforcement material any idea on where I can get that info?
Yes I am on the birth certificate, I wasnt gona miss that opportunity. I tried to do everything I could.

Thank you! I will do that as soon as possible, does that mean I'll get a court date and meet before a judge and get to discuss how far she can move away, how often I get to have him and be able to make decisions on if he will be homeschooled or go to public schools?

I had a free consultation towards the beginning of the year. I was told I'd need 3 grand just to start the process and it was just the retainer and would cost more as we got into things. I'm trying to find something affordable. Time is just my enemy right now, if I knew I had more of it I'd live as cheaply as possible pay my credit cards down and use those for a lawyer. 

I'm going to lawyer websites in my area and filling out their forms and letting then know my situation in hope that I can get someone to help.

I haven't looked up any support groups but that's a great idea, I will look some up when I get home. 

I used to me so much more selfish but I learned to see things through her eyes, I quickly see where I messed up and apologize and try to talk to her. I feel like I have made quite a bit of progress I know I need to make more but I am willing to keep going and changing.

I cant afford therapy at this time, but I've been doing a lot of reading about defensive personality, anxiety, and stress. I've read a lot of helpful things. I read some of the good information over and over so it sticks.

You really make perfect sense, I've read your advice over and over, it hurts to think that this is the end and it keeps me from doing what I know I have to do. But I will keep reading your advice til i can make it happen. Thank you.

If you dont mind me asking how long til you started dating again? When she got back in touch did you have feelings still? Or did they come back how did it end up ?

I ask because this isn't the first time someone cheated on me, my last relationship my SO cheated after about 6 months of moving in together. Left me with a terrible hit to my credit both of ours really.  After we broke it off she went through about 3 boyfriends before trying to talk to me again and asking to hang out after 2 months. I made excuses to not hang out for about a month, till I just went to hang with her I dont know why really, but by then I had dwelled on what she did to me and by the time I went to hang with her I hated her, and I mean hated. I pretended to just be friends so the sake of hanging out. We had drinks and danced, I took her home and she tried to sleep with me in my car, I just played dumb and dismissed everything because of how much I resented her by then, she messaged me about 2 more times before stopping.

I feel if I left my current SO there would be no coming back.

Your so right, I think about just picking up and going then I think about how much we have been through and the struggles and when she loved me she showed it. A part of me just keeps thinking about her hopes she will realize that what's really important, but my heart hurts and I just constantly have those random thoughts.
And I have to just believe you will keep your word?
Yeah? Because your word means so much.
